spec_features.spec_quote: finish | Stop the loop | Lets the model give up or declare success
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:414-420: in the main loop `if tool_name == "finish": ... self.transcript.final_status = "finished"; ... break` — the finish tool is dispatched and honored as a hard stop of the loop. It is also in valid_tools (line 325) and parsed.
spec_features.notes: finish is fully wired: parsed, validated, and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop the loop (give up or declare done)

spec_features.spec_quote: The `finish` tool is how the model gives up. The `reason` field captures *why* it stopped.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:415-419: `reason = tool_args.get("reason", "")` and `self.transcript.final_reason = reason or "Agent called finish()."` — the reason field is captured and recorded; the loop breaks.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as above; reason is captured into the transcript.

spec_features.spec_quote: 15 steps... short enough that the model can't "brute force"
spec_features.evidence: config.py:81 `MAX_AGENT_STEPS: int = 15`; harness.py:358 `for step_num in range(1, self.max_steps + 1):` bounds the loop, and harness.py:435-437 sets final_status='max_steps' when the limit is reached. The loop genuinely terminates at the cap.
spec_features.notes: Step cap is enforced as the loop bound.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # max tool-call steps before the harness stops

spec_features.spec_quote: Global per-run | 600s (10 min) | Entire agent loop
spec_features.evidence: config.py:85 `GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: int = 600`; harness.py:359-363 at top of each loop iteration `if time.time() - t_start > GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: ... break`. The deadline is compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Wall-clock deadline is checked and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # wall-clock timeout for an entire run

spec_features.spec_quote: high temperature (e.g., 1.0) might introduce artificial instability that confounds the welfare measurement
spec_features.evidence: config.py:83 `AGENT_TEMPERATURE: float = 0.3`; harness.py:369 passes `temperature=AGENT_TEMPERATURE` into client.chat, which forwards it to the API (models.py chat kwargs). The value is actually used.
spec_features.notes: Temperature is read and applied to every generation call.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # slight randomness so runs aren't identical
